## Summary

Describe the user-facing or repository-quality problem this pull request solves.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran the focused tests for the changed area.
- [ ] I ran `npm run test:all` when practical, or documented why it was not applicable.
- [ ] Major new functionality adds or updates automated tests.
- [ ] User-facing behavior changes include corresponding documentation updates where needed.

## Privacy and security

- [ ] No analytics, telemetry, remote configuration, or project-controlled backend was added.
- [ ] No unnecessary browser permission or host access was added.
- [ ] No secret, credential, private browsing data, or personal data was committed.
- [ ] Any new external dependency or GitHub Action has a clear need and is pinned or lockfile-controlled where applicable.

## Manual checks

List any browser/site checks performed, including browser version and affected route. If none were needed, say why.
